$comment: Workstations align Agile iteration with systems-engineering verification. Registry agents use factory/02_workforce/02_00_agents/agent-registry.json role ids (pm, dev, …). Human-readable definitions: workstation_definitions/*-workstation.md (one file per stations.<id>).

model.agile: Backlog/refinement → sprint increment (working software) → Definition of Done / CI → release.
model.systems_engineering: Requirements/scope alignment → implementation → integration & verification (IV&V verification / built-right) → transition to operation (deployment); validation (built-right-thing) often cross-cutting via QMS-PUB-001.

backlog_plan.label: Backlog & planning
backlog_plan.agile: Product backlog, refinement, sprint-planning inputs, acceptance language.
backlog_plan.systems_engineering: Stakeholder needs / requirements baseline and scope boundaries.

increment_build.label: Increment build
increment_build.agile: Sprint execution: implement stories, integrate into branch, thin vertical slices.
increment_build.systems_engineering: Design realization / implementation per allocated baseline.

integrate_verify.label: Integrate & verify
integrate_verify.agile: CI, automated tests, DoD — quality gate before merge/release candidate.

release_transition.label: Release & transition
release_transition.agile: Ship increment to envs; operational handoff; release notes.
release_transition.systems_engineering: Transition to use / deployment; operational readiness.
